import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product (Bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette()[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Sales by Size (Pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(size_sales)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(size_sales.values, labels=size_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Sales Trend Over Time (Line chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('datetime')
ax3.plot(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax3.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Time', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sale ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for i, row in df_sorted.iterrows():
    ax3.annotate(f'${row["total"]:.2f}', (row['datetime'], row['total']),
                 textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,10), ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Sales by Age Group (Bar chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
age_order = ['18-24', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax4.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(age_sales)))
ax4.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Payment Method Distribution (Donut chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index,
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
centre_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), 0.70, fc='white')
ax5.add_artist(centre_circle)
ax5.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 6. Price vs Quantity Scatter by Product
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
products = df['product'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", len(products))
for i, product in enumerate(products):
    product_data = df[df['product'] == product]
    ax6.scatter(product_data['price'], product_data['quantity'],
                s=product_data['total']*20, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i],
                label=product, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
    
    # Add labels for each point
    for _, row in product_data.iterrows():
        ax6.annotate(f'${row["total"]:.2f}', (row['price'], row['quantity']),
                     textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,5), ha='center',
                     fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

ax6.set_title('Price vs Quantity by Product\n(Size = Total Sale)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Quantity', fontsize=12)
ax6.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
